LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Th: Keeps your selected Thunder evolution. Refinement increases its corresponding chain damage or bonus damage.
After three damaging basic attacks, you deal bonus damage to up to two other enemies near the impact. Attacks during cooldown do not build progress.
After three consecutive basic attacks on the same enemy deal damage, you deal bonus damage to that enemy. Switching targets resets the count.
After a damaging basic attack, move at least three cells from where you attacked. Your next damaging basic attack deals bonus damage to that enemy.
Shields build charge by absorbing hostile damage, excluding shields from your own tree. Once full, your next eligible basic attack spends it for extra damage.
Branching Current damage leaves a brief mark on the enemy it hits. Your next eligible basic attack on that enemy consumes the mark for extra damage.
Piercing Charge damage leaves a brief opening. Thunderfall consumes that opening on hit to refund part of its remaining cooldown, once per cast.
Stormstep damage leaves a brief footprint at your attack position; only the latest is kept. Move far enough away, then an eligible basic attack consumes it to damage enemies near the footprint.
A damaging Storm Reservoir discharge grants you a brief shield. Your own tree’s shields cannot recharge your reservoir.
After two Branching Currents each damage two different enemies, the next strikes the farthest other enemy in range of its first arc impact. That release does not count toward the next cycle.
A damaging Twin Feed leaves paired contacts. A basic attack near either contact spends the pair to damage enemies near the other end; no enemy there leaves the pair intact.

A basic attack that spends your Conductive Trace links that impact to another enemy with your trace. The fixed wire damages enemies walking across it, stays in place and leaves the other trace unspent.

After one Live Fence damages two different enemies, your next Thunderfall cast opens a triangular boundary from its saved endpoints, replacing the wire and damaging crossing enemies. The preparation survives the original wire's expiry.

Consume your Conductive Traces on two different enemies in succession to place a needle at the second impact. Thunderfall hitting near it spends the needle to strike another enemy; without another enemy, it remains.

Lightning Needle damage leaves a charged anchor. From far enough away, your next eligible basic attack pulls it one grid step toward you and spends it to damage an enemy near that short path; without a target, it remains.

Branching Current damage gives a relay port to the nearest other free colonist in range. Their basic attack on an enemy with your Conductive Trace spends the port to shield both of you, leaving your trace unspent.

After your ally completes Relay Port, land a basic attack on a different enemy before the opportunity expires to strike near their saved impact and your new impact. With no valid target, the opportunity remains.

While your Open Circuit opening remains, every two consecutive basic attacks on that enemy extend it, up to twice; changing targets resets partial progress. Thunderfall adds a lightning strike when it spends the fully extended opening.

Spending a fully extended opening with Thunderfall prepares your next damaging Piercing Charge to strike another enemy in line behind its target. That Piercing Charge spends the preparation even if no enemy is lined up.
Piercing Charge damage leaves a brief Circuit Breaker mark on that enemy. Moving far enough from the marked position triggers one extra lightning strike.
Circuit Breaker damage leaves a pursuit mark. Thunderfall spends it on hit to pass a movement-triggered Circuit Breaker mark to another nearby enemy; the transferred mark cannot relay again.
Spending an Open Circuit opening schedules a delayed lightning pulse at that impact position. It damages nearby enemies when it lands and does not follow the original target.
Before Delayed Pole lands, a basic attack on a different enemy adds a second pulse at the new impact. It lands after the first pulse, once per opening.

At low health, spending an Open Circuit opening adds damage to that enemy or repairs your own healable wounds, according to your selected mode. Both modes share a recovery timer; switch through Combat choices outside combat.

After Risk Voltage deals damage or repairs an injury, block or suffer enemy damage within its response window to prepare extra damage for your next damaging Piercing Charge. Shields from your own tree do not count.
Leave your Storm Footprint, then return near it before it expires to prepare a return. Your next damaging Stormstep spends that preparation to strike the footprint's original target.

After returns from two different footprints deal damage, the following Stormstep leaves a ring at your attack position. It damages enemies walking across its boundary; standing inside or teleporting across does not trigger it.
After Stormstep deals damage, strike another enemy near the straight segment between your own previous basic-attack position and your current position. The main target is excluded.

Change direction enough across three consecutive Stormsteps to prepare a bend. A later damaging Corner Cutter spends it to strike another nearby enemy, excluding both previous targets; without another enemy, the bend remains ready.
Stormstep damage gives a brief conductor to the nearest other free colonist in range. Their basic attack after moving far enough from where they received it spends the conductor to shield you.

After your ally completes Moving Conductor, trigger Stormstep near where they first received it before the opportunity expires to strike enemies around you. With no nearby enemy, the opportunity remains.

After Stormstep deals damage, stay in the same cell until ready; your next eligible basic attack spends the preparation for extra lightning damage. Moving to another cell cancels it, even after it is ready.

Stillness Coil damage leaves a static circle at your position. Leave it, then hit an enemy inside with Thunderfall to spend the circle and shield yourself plus the nearest other free colonist in range; without an ally, you still receive a shield.

After Storm Reservoir fills, another shield absorption of enemy damage within the counter window empowers your next reservoir discharge. The filling absorption cannot count again, and shields from your own tree do not count.
When empowered Recoil Current damages the attacker whose hit filled your reservoir, chain damage to another enemy near that attacker. Hitting someone else keeps the counter bonus but grants no arc.

Split Residual Charge equally between you and the nearest other free colonist in range; without one, keep the normal self shield. If enemy attacks fully absorb both shields before expiry, empower your next reservoir discharge.

After enemy attacks fully absorb both Split Reservoir shields before expiry, your next Thunderfall cast shields you and the original partner; no hit is required. If that partner is no longer eligible, only you receive a shield.

Cast Thunderfall with a full Storm Reservoir to store its charge in a grounding rod instead of the normal discharge. Move far enough away and land a basic attack before expiry to strike near the attacker that filled it; expired charge is not refunded.

Move far enough from the grounding rod, then walk back onto its original cell before expiry to spend it for a self shield. This replaces its damage, returns no charge and cannot be activated by teleporting.

With a full Storm Reservoir, healing another injured free colonist in range can spend its charge for extra healing. Requires an existing heal and shares charge with discharge; fully repairing the patient's wounds with the original heal spends no charge.

Rescue Spark restoring wounds leaves a brief link to that patient. Absorbing enemy damage with a shield while the link remains spends it to shield the patient, excluding absorption by shields from your own tree.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Fl: Retain your chosen Flame evolution. Refinement strengthens spreading burns or the detonation bonus; consumed burn damage keeps its original budget.
Build a brand with basic attacks on the last victim hit. A later basic attack spends your brand for extra damage; bonus damage cannot create another brand.
Basic attacks build heat. At full heat, the next basic attack spends it for extra damage and starts the vent cooldown; bonus damage produces no heat.
Firebrand bonus damage leaves your tinder on its victim. A Worldfire field hit spends that tinder for extra damage; no tinder means no bonus.
After Firebrand deals damage, you deal bonus damage to one other enemy near the impact.
After Furnace Heart deals damage, you deal bonus damage to up to two other enemies near the impact.
After Furnace Heart deals damage, you gain a temporary shield.
Chasing Flame bonus damage plants a delayed cinder at the impact cell to damage nearby enemies. The cinder stays on the ground instead of following its victim.
After Flying Cinders deals damage, briefly mark that enemy. A later basic attack on the same enemy spends the mark for bonus damage.
When one Furnace Vent damages two different secondary victims, create a cinder bed at the primary victim's old cell. A basic attack on an enemy near the bed spends it for one damage bonus.
After Bank the Fire absorbs enemy damage, a basic attack on the latest attacker spends the record to return that absorption, up to the counter cap. Other shields provide no energy.
Before Falling Embers erupts, move from inside its cinder area to outside it, then land a basic attack to detonate that same cinder early. It pays once and creates no new cinder.
After Falling Embers damages an enemy, remember it. A later Worldfire field hit spends your record for a burst at the victim's current position; it creates no new cinder.

Spend Passing Fire embers on two different enemies within the time limit to prepare Converging Flames. Your next basic attack spends it for extra damage; repeating one enemy neither counts nor renews the window.
After Passing Fire deals damage, you heal the other free colonist with the worst healable wounds near you.

A live cinder bed lets heat rebuild during the vent cooldown and extend that bed once. Spending the extended bed uses extra heat for bonus damage; without enough heat, only the bed's own damage is dealt.

After spending a cinder bed, walk away from your recorded position and hit another enemy with a basic attack. Shield up to two allied colonists near the old bed; the chance is spent even without recipients.

Returning Heat bonus damage remembers that enemy. Another basic attack spends your record to extend its standard weapon shooting warmup; without an eligible warmup, the record keeps its original expiry.
After Returning Heat deals bonus damage, grant a nearby other colonist a shield scaled from that damage. This shield cannot trigger Returning Heat.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Bl: Keep your chosen Blood evolution. Refinement increases its overheal-to-shield conversion or healing on kills.
While you have healable wounds, after three consecutive basic attacks deal damage, you heal your own wounds.
After a basic attack deals damage, you heal the other free colonist with the worst healable wounds near you.
Drink from the Blade restoring wounds prepares one Wetted Edge opportunity. A later basic attack spends it for extra damage; it neither stacks nor renews, and the healing hit cannot spend it.
Drink from the Blade restoring wounds stores one charge. Casting Crimson sovereign spends it for a personal shield; an existing charge neither stacks nor renews.
After Share the Blood heals, a basic attack on an enemy different from the healing hit's target shields the original patient. Each healing opportunity pays once.

After Share the Blood heals, walk and land a basic attack near that patient's current position to mend their healable wounds again. Teleporting does not count; no healable wounds preserves only the original deadline.
Wetted Edge bonus damage leaves your blood trace on its victim. A Crimson sovereign hit spends that trace for extra damage; no trace means no bonus.
After Held Blood's shield absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack on the latest attacker adds counter damage, once per shield round. Later blocks do not renew the deadline.

After Keep the Pulse's shield absorbs enemy damage, a basic attack heals the most injured nearby other colonist, excluding the shield's original patient. With no eligible patient, only the original deadline remains.
After Stay Close heals again, shield its patient if their total health remains below half. Check health after healing; each follow-up pays once.
After Crimson sovereign spends your blood trace and deals bonus damage, a basic attack on another enemy heals your wounds. Each cast prepares one opportunity without stacking or renewal.
Blood Trace bonus damage heals your wounds. Grant a personal shield only after recovery, once per ability cast.
After Returning Tide deals real counter damage, walk away from your recorded position, then land a close basic attack on another enemy for one damage bonus. Teleporting does not count.
Returning Tide counter damage shields the nearest other colonist nearby. With no ally, heal your own healable wounds instead; these outcomes are exclusive and are not stored for later.
After Give Back heals another colonist, shield the original Keep the Pulse patient. The recipient stays the original patient, and this new shield cannot restart Give Back.
After Give Back heals, walk and land a basic attack near that patient's saved healing position to grant shields to you and the patient. The area stays fixed if the patient moves.
After Hold the Wound's shield absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack heals its original patient's healable wounds, once per shield round. Later blocks do not renew the deadline.

After Hold the Wound grants its shield, walk outside the patient's saved grant area, then land a close basic attack on a different enemy to heal the most injured other colonist nearby. The original patient is excluded.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Ti: Keep your chosen Giant evolution. Refinement increases its quake damage or the shield gained while stationary.
Build progress with close basic attacks to deal extra damage to the triggering hit's victim. Distant hits and bonus damage do not count; weapon type and racial body size are unrestricted.
A close basic attack grants you a personal shield. This layer does not stack with itself, bonus damage cannot trigger it, and racial body size is unrestricted.
Breach the Line bonus damage leaves your pressure mark on its victim. An Earthshatter hit spends that mark for extra damage; no pressure means no bonus.
After Breach the Line deals damage, you deal bonus damage to one other enemy near the impact.
After Brace absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack on the latest attacker spends its record to return that absorption, up to the counter cap. Absorbed hits do not accumulate.
Casting Earthshatter shields up to two other colonists nearby without requiring a hit. No ally means no shield, and the ability's cooldown is unchanged.
Earthshatter spending your pressure mark leaves a seam on that victim. A later close basic attack spends the seam for extra damage without creating new pressure.

Shoulder Through splash damage records both original impact cells. Walk away from their connecting segment, then land a close basic attack to spend the fault on enemies near its ends; empty ground still spends it.

Complete Answer the Blow returns against different attackers within the time limit to store Hold Formation. Your next Earthshatter cast spends it for a personal shield; repeating one attacker does not count.

After Shoulder to Shoulder absorbs enemy damage, remember the first protected ally. Walk and land a basic attack near their current position to heal healable wounds, once per round; later blocks do not renew it.
Spending a seam can extend its victim's current standard weapon shooting warmup, once per seam. Airborne projectiles and special boss timers are unchanged.
seam damage first heals your wounds. After recovery, walk away from the saved position and land a close basic attack for one more heal; teleporting does not count.
When both ends of one fault damage different enemies, prepare Converging Faults. A later Earthshatter hit spends it for area damage near that impact; the opportunity neither stacks nor renews.
After Fault Line deals damage, shield up to two allied colonists near the original midpoint between its impact cells. The area stays fixed, following neither caster nor enemies, once per fault.

After Hold Formation's shield absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack on the latest attacker adds damage and reduces Earthshatter's remaining cooldown. Once per round; later blocks do not renew the deadline.

When Earthshatter spends Hold Formation, replace its personal shield with shields for you and the nearest other colonist nearby. Without an ally, keep the original personal shield; old shield remainder is not copied.
After Close Ranks heals, walk outside the patient's saved healing area, then land a close basic attack on a different enemy to shield that same patient. Patient movement does not shift the area.
After Close Ranks heals, shield its patient if total health remains below half. Once that shield absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack can heal the same patient's healable wounds again, once.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Fr: Retain your chosen Frost evolution. Refinement strengthens only its damage; relic awakenings are unaffected.
Progress from basic attacks leaves rime on the triggering hit's victim for later nodes to spend. The mark adds no slow.
Casting Absolute zero grants you a personal shield, even without hitting an enemy.
An Absolute zero hit consumes your own rime mark on the victim for extra damage. No mark means no bonus.
A basic attack spends your rime to extend the enemy's current standard weapon shooting warmup. It adds no stun; without an eligible warmup, the mark keeps its original expiry.
After Ice Mantle absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack on the latest attacker returns the latest absorbed amount, up to the cap, once per shield round.
After Ice Mantle is granted, a basic attack shields the nearest other colonist nearby, once per round. No ally leaves only the original opportunity deadline.
After Shatter deals damage, a basic attack on another enemy damages at most one enemy near the saved impact cell. Empty ground still spends the opportunity; only the latest landing is kept.
After Freeze a Beat extends an enemy's weapon warmup, walk and land another basic attack on that enemy for extra damage, once per delay. Teleporting does not count as walking.
Complete Ice Edge counters against two different enemies within the time limit to bank a charge. Your next Absolute zero cast spends it for a personal shield; charges neither stack nor renew.
After Shared Cold's shield absorbs enemy damage, walk and land a basic attack near its original grant cell to heal the recipient's healable wounds. The area stays fixed if the recipient moves.
After Falling Splinters deals damage, walk away from your recorded position, then land a close basic attack on an enemy other than its victim for extra damage, once per opportunity.
After Falling Splinters deals damage, shield the nearest other colonist nearby. With no ally, grant yourself a smaller shield instead; each round grants only one of these shields.
After Cold Opening deals damage, a basic attack on another enemy grants you a shield, once per opening. The opportunity keeps its original expiry.
After Cold Opening deals damage, walk back near your position recorded when Freeze a Beat delayed the warmup, then land a basic attack to heal your wounds. Teleporting does not count.
After Banked Cold's shield absorbs enemy damage, the first later Absolute zero cast that hits adds damage to at most two distinct enemies hit by that same cast.
When Banked Cold grants your personal shield, also grant shields to up to two other colonists nearby. A failed personal grant provides no ally shields.
After Cold Link heals, grant its original recipient a shield. This new shield cannot restart Cold Link.

After Cold Link heals, walk outside the area around the patient's recorded healing position, then land a close basic attack on a different enemy to heal the most injured nearby other colonist. The area stays fixed if the original patient moves.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Bl: Keep your chosen Blade evolution. Refinement increases its bonus damage.
Consecutive close basic attacks on the same enemy build your edge mark. Switching eligible targets or leaving a hit gap resets progress; distant hits and bonus damage do not count.
Close basic attacks on different enemies within the time limit grant you a personal shield. Repeating one enemy neither advances progress nor renews the counting window.
A Bladestorm hit spends your edge mark on its victim for extra damage. Later hits add no bonus without a new mark.

A close basic attack spends your edge mark and records both positions. Walk across the line through the saved target cell, then damage that enemy with a close-range basic attack for bonus damage; target movement cannot shift the line.

After Crossed Blades absorbs enemy damage, a close basic attack on the latest attacker returns the latest absorbed amount, up to the cap. Each shield round pays once; later blocks do not renew the deadline.

After Crossed Blades grants its shield, a close basic attack marks an enemy for relay. Another allied colonist's basic attack on that enemy grants that colonist a shield; the author cannot claim it, once per round.

After Closing Cut deals bonus damage, a close basic attack on another enemy gives it a fresh edge mark. Keep one marked victim; the new mark replaces the old one without resetting Held Edge progress or cooldown.
After Feint deals bonus damage, a later Bladestorm hit on that same enemy adds damage once. Losing the original target does not transfer the reward to another enemy.

After Back of the Blade deals real return damage, walk and land a close basic attack on its attacker to mend your wounds. With no healable wound, keep only the original deadline; teleporting cancels the opportunity.
After the relay ally's exact Blades Together shield absorbs enemy damage, your close basic attack on the original marked enemy adds damage once. Other shield layers do not fuel it.
When Closing Cut spends Returning Edge's fresh mark and deals damage, grant yourself a shield, once per transferred mark. Ordinary Held Edge marks do not qualify.
After Closing Cut spends a transferred mark and deals damage, walk away from your saved position and land a close basic attack on another enemy for one bonus. Passing Edge creates no new edge mark.

After Flanking Edge deals bonus damage, walk outside the area around its victim's saved position, then land a close basic attack on another enemy for one bonus. The victim's movement does not shift that area.

After Flanking Edge deals bonus damage, shield the nearest other colonist nearby. With no ally, grant yourself a smaller shield instead; these outcomes are exclusive and later pulses cannot claim them again.
After Fight On mends your injuries, grant yourself a shield, once per round. This new layer cannot restart Back of the Blade.

After Fight On heals, a close basic attack on another enemy heals the most severe healable wounds on another colonist nearby. With no eligible patient, retain the original deadline without renewing it.
After Pincer deals damage, grant a new shield to the original Blades Together relay ally, once per round. The recipient stays the same, and this shield cannot restart Pincer.

After Pincer deals damage, walk outside the original relay ally's saved area, then land a close basic attack on another enemy to heal the most injured other colonist nearby. Exclude yourself and the original ally.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Ma: Keep your chosen Sharpshooter evolution. Refinement increases its distant-hit bonus or piercing damage.
Consecutive distant basic attacks on the same enemy build your sight mark. Switching eligible targets or leaving a hit gap resets progress; close hits and bonus damage do not count.
Distant basic attacks on different enemies within the time limit give the latter your line mark. Repeated hits on one enemy neither advance progress nor renew the counting window.
A Starpiercer hit spends your sight mark on its victim for bonus damage. Later hits add no bonus without a new mark.
A distant basic attack spends your sight mark to delay the enemy's equipped-gun warmup. Without a native gun warmup, keep the mark.

A distant basic attack spends your line mark and records both positions. Walk farther from the saved enemy cell, then damage that enemy with a distant basic attack for bonus damage; teleporting cancels the chance.
A distant basic attack spends your line mark to open a relay. Another allied colonist's basic attack on that enemy triggers bonus damage credited to you; you cannot claim your own relay.

Pierce the Gap damage records the old firing line. A distant basic attack on another enemy damages a different enemy near that line, excluding the triggering victim; no candidate preserves the original deadline.
After Suppress Aim delays a warmup, a distant basic attack on another enemy warming up its equipped gun adds damage once. Without an eligible warmup, retain the original deadline.

After Step Back deals bonus damage, walk near your original firing position, then damage another enemy with a distant basic attack to mend healable wounds. With none to mend, retain the original deadline.
Relay Shot damage shields the relay ally. After that layer first absorbs enemy damage, a distant basic attack on the original relay victim adds damage once; the target remains that victim.
After Lingering Line deals damage, walk away from the old line, then damage another enemy with a distant basic attack for bonus damage once. Both endpoints stay fixed; teleporting cancels the chance.
After Lingering Line deals damage, shield the nearest other colonist near the old line. With no ally, grant yourself a smaller shield instead; these outcomes are exclusive, once per round.
After Cut the Shot deals damage, a distant basic attack on another enemy warming up its equipped gun delays that warmup. Once per round; this delay cannot restart Cut the Shot.
After Cut the Shot deals damage, grant yourself a shield, once per round. Without bonus damage, no shield is granted; this layer does not trigger Relay Shot or Covering Fire.

After Return Fire heals, walk away from the healing position, then damage Step Back’s original target with a distant basic attack for bonus damage once. The original target stays fixed; teleporting cancels the chance.

After Return Fire heals, a distant basic attack on another enemy heals the most severe healable wounds on another colonist nearby. With no eligible patient, retain the original deadline without renewing it.
After Covering Fire deals bonus damage, grant a new shield to the original Relay Shot ally, once per round. The recipient stays the same; this layer cannot restart the cover reply.

After Covering Fire deals damage, walk farther from the relay ally's saved cell, then damage another enemy with a distant basic attack to shield the nearest third colonist nearby. Exclude yourself and the original ally.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Sp: Keep your chosen Soul evolution. Refinement increases its healing on kills or bonus soul damage.
Consecutive basic attacks on the same enemy build your focus mark. Switching targets or leaving a hit gap resets progress; abilities and bonus damage do not count.
An Night procession hit leaves your aftertone mark. Later pulses during recovery neither renew nor move it; basic attacks and other abilities do not trigger it.
A Night procession hit spends your focus mark on its victim for bonus damage. Later pulses add no bonus without fresh focus.
A basic attack spends your focus to leave a fixed anchor at impact. A later Night procession hit near that point grants you a shield; a pending anchor or shield recovery prevents replacement.
A basic attack spends your aftertone mark to damage the nearest other enemy near its victim. With no second enemy, keep the mark without extending its expiry.
A basic attack spends your aftertone mark to mend the most severe healable wounds on another colonist nearby. Scars are excluded; with no eligible patient, keep the mark without renewing it.
Soul Rend damage records its impact cell. A basic attack on another enemy damages up to two enemies near that old cell, excluding the triggering victim; an empty area preserves the original deadline.

After the bound shield first absorbs enemy damage, walk near its fixed anchor and damage the first attacker with a basic attack to mend your wounds. Once per round; later blocks do not renew the deadline.

Draw the Soul damage marks its victim. The first other colonist to damage it with a basic attack receives a shield; you cannot claim it. The pending relay and shield recovery prevent target replacement.

After Soul Offering heals, remember its patient. A Night procession hit on another enemy shields that original patient nearby, once per round. Later pulses cannot refill it, and shield recovery prevents resetting the round.

After Fractured Echo first deals damage, a Night procession hit on a different enemy from its first victim damages up to two other enemies near the new target. Once per round; no candidate preserves the original deadline.

After Fractured Echo first deals damage, walk near its fixed impact area and damage an enemy with a basic attack for a personal shield. Once per round; teleporting cancels it, and later hits cannot refill or extend it.
After Return to the Circle heals, walk outside the fixed anchor's area and damage another enemy with a basic attack for bonus damage, once per round. Standing still or teleporting cannot claim it.
After Return to the Circle heals, a basic attack on another enemy heals the most severe healable wounds on another colonist nearby, once per round. With no patient, retain the original deadline.
After Joined Voices first absorbs enemy damage, your Night procession hit on the first attacker adds soul damage, once per shield round. Later blocks neither change the target nor renew the deadline.
After Joined Voices first absorbs enemy damage, walk closer to its original shielded ally and, while near that ally, land a basic attack for a personal shield. Once per round; teleporting cancels it.

While Return Passage's shield remains active, its original patient can damage the enemy that triggered the grant with a basic attack for soul damage. Damage is credited to the shield author, once per passage; nobody else can claim it.

After Return Passage first absorbs enemy damage, walk closer to its original patient and use a basic attack to damage an enemy other than the first attacker to mend that patient's healable wounds. No eligible wound preserves the original deadline; teleporting cancels it.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_Gu: Keep your chosen Guardian evolution. Refinement increases its retaliation damage or sanctuary shield strength.

After your shield absorbs enemy damage, remember the first attacker. A basic attack on that enemy adds damage once; waiting neither changes the target nor renews the deadline, and abilities or bonus damage cannot claim it.
A basic attack shields the other eligible colonist near you who is closest to the victim. They must also be near that enemy; with none eligible, preserve the cooldown.
After Brace deals bonus damage, another basic attack on the same enemy adds damage once. A new Brace cannot replace an unclaimed opportunity that has not expired.

After Brace deals damage, walk away from the trigger position, then damage another enemy with a basic attack for a personal shield. A pending chance or active new shield prevents resetting the round; teleporting cancels it.

After Cover first absorbs enemy damage, the original shielded ally can damage that first attacker with a basic attack for bonus damage. Credit the shield author, once per round; nobody else can claim it.

After Cover first absorbs enemy damage, the original shielded ally walks closer to the shield author and, while nearby, lands a basic attack to mend their own healable wounds. Once per round; teleporting cancels it.

Behind the Shield damage leaves an opening on that enemy. The first other colonist to damage it with a basic attack adds damage credited to you; you cannot claim it, and waiting neither changes the target nor renews the deadline.

After Yield the Edge first absorbs enemy damage, walk again and use a basic attack to damage an enemy other than the first attacker for bonus damage, once per round. Later blocks neither change the target nor renew the deadline; teleporting cancels it.
After the original ally's Call the Target deals damage, your basic attack on that enemy damages the nearest other enemy nearby, once per round. With no second enemy, retain the original deadline.

After Cover the Return heals, your basic attack on another enemy grants a new shield to the original patient nearby, once per round. Keep that ally's identity; this layer cannot restart Cover rewards.

After Open the Guard deals damage, your basic attack on another enemy strikes the original opening victim if still within your range, once per round. Never redirect the strike when that victim becomes ineligible.

After Open the Guard deals damage, walk closer to the original relay ally and damage an enemy with a basic attack nearby to shield both participants separately. An existing Shields Together layer on either participant preserves the original deadline; teleporting cancels it.

After Cross the Line deals damage, walk closer to its victim and damage that same enemy with a basic attack for bonus damage once. A new crossing cannot replace the chance; target movement never resets your walking origin.

After Cross the Line deals damage, walk back near Yield the Edge's original position and damage an enemy with a basic attack to heal the most severe healable wounds on another colonist nearby. With no patient, retain the original deadline.

After Close In deals damage to its second victim, the original Call the Target ally can damage that victim with a basic attack for bonus damage credited to you, once per round. Nobody else can claim it or restart Close In.
After Close In deals damage to its second victim, a later basic attack on another enemy shields the original Call the Target ally nearby, once per round. This layer cannot trigger Cover rewards.

After Form Up Again first absorbs enemy damage, the original patient walks and, while outside the shield author's area, damages the first attacker with a basic attack for bonus damage credited to that author. Once per round; teleporting cancels it.

After Form Up Again first absorbs enemy damage, your basic attack on another enemy heals the most severe healable wounds on a third colonist near the original patient. Exclude yourself and that patient; with nobody eligible, retain the deadline.
LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Path_We: Keep your chosen Wealth evolution. Refinement increases its silver income, with fractional silver carried into later settlements.

When cumulative net trade income exceeds its previous peak, the increase earns a silver dividend. Purchases count as expenses; buying back and reselling cannot pay twice. Fractions persist in one colony account.

New peak net income banks procurement credit instead of cash. Later trades with a net silver expense refund part of that expense, limited by saved credit. Unused credit persists; leaving this branch pauses redemption.

Accumulated new peak net income earns freight receipts. A later trade with fresh income redeems older receipts; new ones wait for another trade. Splitting orders adds no receipts, and surplus progress carries forward.
Trades with fresh net income record goods exported. Collect distinct products to complete a docket, then export a different product for fresh income to redeem it. Split stacks count once.

Eligible industrial purchases first spend procurement credit to register supplies. Completed recipes replenish the same funded materials only after consumption. Fractions persist; resale cancels funded quantities first, and hauling adds none.

Procurement credit registers food or medicine. Supplies return only after colonist consumption. Surgery must finish its medical-bill processing and consume medicine; its clinical outcome need not succeed, but an exception grants nothing.

Redeeming freight earns a rotation supplement only when you export goods absent from the preceding batch. Repeated goods still redeem ordinary freight, without the supplement; fresh net income is required.

Completing a docket opens a timed order with that trader. Export goods for fresh net income to another trader, then do the same with the original trader to settle it. One order at a time; expiry pays nothing.

A completed recipe with funded consumption opens a supply relay, even below one whole item. A different colonist completing a different recipe with funded consumption settles the old order; settlement cannot open another.

Alternating funded food and medicine consumption earns rotation supplements. The first use starts the sequence while ordinary supplies continue; repeated use of one category adds no supplement. Terms come from the preceding switch, and fractions persist.

Payable freight and rotation supplements become industrial procurement credit. Later purchases of eligible industrial goods with a net silver expense refund part of that expense, limited by saved credit. Refunds never count as fresh trade income.

LanguageData.RHA_Readability032_Node_RHA_STAR_Core_mi: Requires the Prismatic Mines core. Keep Deploy Mine, Detonate Mine and Disarm Mine; advancement refreshes neither mine lifetime nor deployment recovery.
